events.event_hazard: Tropical Cyclone Phailin (high winds and storm surge)
key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh were affected by the cyclone.
Coastal areas faced fierce winds and a storm surge.
Mean winds around 120 kt (222 kph); a gust of 185 kph was observed at Gopalpur.

events.event_hazard: Flooding from torrential rainfall following Cyclone Phailin
key_impacts: Significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Subsequent floods claimed 23 more lives in Odisha.
Subsequent floods claimed 1 life in Andhra Pradesh.
